retrievalProfile.description: A retro-futuristic composition featuring a glowing animal silhouette against a ringed planet and a geometric circuit-like starfield.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition framed by black borders containing a central ringed planet and a howling wolf silhouette. The background is a dense starfield overlaid with a glowing, cyan-and-magenta geometric circuit pattern. The wolf is rendered as a white, pixelated or glowing outline, while the planet features soft airbrushed gradients of blue and white.
coreVisualRelationships: The wolf silhouette anchors the bottom-left foreground against the celestial background.
The diagonal rings of the planet create a dynamic cross-axis against the horizontal text.
The geometric circuit pattern provides a structured texture over the organic starfield.
High-contrast black borders isolate the vibrant cosmic scene.
coreInvariants: A glowing, jagged-edged animal silhouette in the lower quadrant.
A large ringed planet occupying the central and upper-right space.
A background texture consisting of a grid-like or circuit-like geometric pattern.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The wolf is positioned in the lower-left, scaled to approximately one-third of the frame height. The planet is central and large, dominating the upper two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white glow of the wolf silhouette serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the wolf's upward gaze to the diagonal rings of the planet, then to the display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black borders at the top and bottom provide breathing room for the dense, textured central image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep space blue and black serve as the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan and magenta define the geometric patterns and planet highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the wolf outline and stars; muted red for the top display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon patterns contrasts with the dark, low-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses extremely tall, narrow vertical proportions with rounded terminals.
Bottom text uses wide, classical serif proportions with extreme letter-spacing.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'S' in the top text have elongated vertical stems.
The 'W' in the bottom text has a wide, traditional spread.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme vertical compression at the top paired with extreme horizontal expansion at the bottom.

preserve: Ultra-condensed verticality of the top text
Extreme tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed verticality of the top display text.
Matches the wide, spaced-out serif feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square cosmic scene with a large ringed planet in the center-right and a glowing white silhouette of a howling wolf in the bottom-left. Overlay the entire scene with a cyan and magenta geometric circuit-board pattern and a dense starfield. Frame the image with thick black bars at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed, tall red sans-serif text centered in the top black bar. Add wide-spaced, small white serif text centered in the bottom black bar.

verificationChecks: Is the wolf silhouette glowing white and jagged?
Are the top and bottom borders solid black?
Is the top text vertically elongated?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-spaced?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band logos or trademarked symbols.
Ensure the circuit pattern is a generic geometric overlay, not a specific technical diagram.

mustAchieve: Airbrushed gradient look on the planet

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is confined to the black borders.
Verify the circuit pattern does not obscure the wolf silhouette.
Ensure the planet rings have a soft, airbrushed glow.
Confirm the top text is significantly taller than it is wide.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a glowing animal silhouette with a ringed celestial body, overlay with a neon geometric grid, and frame with high-contrast, extreme-proportioned typography in black borders.
